mission.goal: Integrate the verified-v4 heartbeat foundation as the sole policy and recommendation authority while preserving the existing catalogue, SQLite, Bible, runtime, MCP, CLI and scheduler surfaces only as truthful bounded facades or scaffolding.
mission.user: OWNER-A1B2C3D4 and governed metadata-only EvidenceOps consumers
mission.workflow: explicit input produces local metadata observations; verified-v4 applies A0 policy; a registered runtime signer creates complete lineage; a fresh registered destination signs acceptance; the SQLite facade atomically records only codes, hashes, enums, timestamps and receipts; scheduled paths inventory only
mission.data: field-bound pseudonymous owner, matter, mission, node, capability, key and transaction codes; classifications, state codes, capability hashes, complete signed lineages, fresh receipts, immutable ledgers, synthetic catalogues and metadata-only local SQLite records
mission.interface: Python library and inventory CLIs; SQLite compatibility facade; runtime API and MCP heartbeat contracts are explicit unimplemented activation obligations
mission.stack: Python 3.12 standard library and local SQLite only
mission.environment: Federation Omega source tree and caller-injected local runtime signers; no network, provider, cloud, secret, API, MCP or deployment route
mission.governance: Formation A1 controls one bounded reversible local integration; runtime heartbeat authority is exactly A0; verified-v4 is the only policy, signing, receipt and respawn authority
mission.failure: fail closed on raw or unknown input, duplicate JSON, path escape, missing authority, scope or classification drift, A1-A5 runtime authority, effectful route, unregistered or stale node, forged or incomplete lineage, hop overflow, rotation mismatch, stale receipt, replay conflict, stop fence, fixture ingress or false live-awareness claim
mission.testing: 30 corrected integration regressions with a complete 24-test legacy map, 92 verified-v4 foundation regressions, the exact 55-test compatibility suite, static integrity verification, MODISA validators, documentation gate, compilation and public leak guard
mission.deployment: not published, registered, attached, deployed or proven; runtime API, MCP tools, durable production storage and provider-backed activation are later Formation missions
mission.continuity: deterministic policy and event identities, immutable foundation values, SQLite atomic metadata receipts, full-payload idempotency, stop generation, respawn semantic readback, six handoff/control documents and inventory-only scheduler readback

assumptions.runtime: an explicit caller injects a complete verified-v4 authority session; standalone CLIs and scheduler remain inventory-only
assumptions.storage: immutable foundation state plus a local SQLite compatibility facade that stores metadata-only atomic receipts; durable multi-instance production storage is not implemented
assumptions.authentication: caller-injected runtime HMAC verifiers exactly bound to fresh registry records; no static key, key discovery, IAM, token, API or MCP authentication implementation
assumptions.deployment: no publication, deployment or live attachment authority or route is included
